integrity: The six public documents and three proof artifacts are embedded with exact SHA-256 and decoded byte counts; the numerical discovery of certificate entries is not evidence, because their complete integer identities and rank bounds are checked by standalone programs. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the 288 completed 4-by-4 Shidoku boards. No extension to larger Sudoku, optimal noisy sampling, or full historical-priority guarantee. An especially relevant earlier chapter on Sudoku design indicators was available in abstract/extract only.
title: Exact graded Walsh tomography of Shidoku and its 24-dimensional cubic blind space
